title: Release D (frontend only): heart shows 'liked by others' as a subtly bolder light-purple outline; my like stays solid purple
protocol: Kiro Supervised. Kiro edits ONLY the 2 files in scope, writing each file's FULL content exactly as given in edits[].content with the IDE write tool. Read-only git (GIT_PAGER=cat) and the gate commands below only. C runs every mutating git, AWS and docker command. No cwd parameter; every command starts with an absolute cd. Run commands one at a time. Run G5 (eslint) through the background-process tool wrapped in bash -c.
must_not: any AWS CLI, docker, bin/ script, install, npx without --no-install
editing any file not in scope (heart.svg and heart-filled.svg are NOT edited)
hand-editing a file to force a gate to pass — report the failure instead

stop0.then: Reply 'STOP 0 complete' with each result and wait for GO.

edits.action: replace the whole file with content (LF, trailing newline exactly as shown)
replace the whole file with content (LF, trailing newline exactly as shown)

gates.on_fail: Report the diff; only CRLF / trailing-newline may be corrected. Otherwise STOP.

gates.cmd: bash -c 'cd ~/aws-bootcamp-cruddur-2023/frontend-react-js && npx --no-install eslint src/components/ActivityActionLike.js; echo exit=$?'

tested_by_claude: Rendered heart.svg at its real 18px size in Chromium with stroke-width 0/8/12/16/24 on black; C chose 8 from the render: a subtle step up from the plain outline. Hover rule .action:hover .icon (specificity 0,4,0) does not override the new rule (0,5,0).
report: Paste every STOP 0 and gate command with full output.

c_after_kiro.1_commit: git add the 2 files + _docs/specs/kiro-spec-release-d.json; git commit -m 'Release D: liked-by-others heart (light-purple, subtly bolder outline)'; git push origin kiro-dev
c_after_kiro.2_frontend:
./bin/frontend/build, then:
REPO=frontend-react-js; CFG=aws/cfn/frontend/config.toml
NEW=$(aws ecr describe-images --repository-name $REPO --query 'sort_by(imageDetails,&imagePushedAt)[-1].imageDigest' --output text)
aws ecr describe-images --repository-name $REPO --image-ids imageDigest=$NEW --query 'imageDetails[0].[imagePushedAt,imageTags]' --output text
echo "$NEW"; echo -n "${NEW#sha256:}" | wc -c
grep -n EcrImage $CFG
# CHECK: pushed a minute ago, 64 chars, NOT the current digest (d56787a8…). Then:
sed -i "s|$REPO@sha256:[^']*'|$REPO@$NEW'|" $CFG
grep -n EcrImage $CFG
./bin/cfn/frontend-deploy

verify_after_deploy: Hard refresh. A post only someone else liked ('New Crud no Dud!'): light-purple, slightly bolder outline with a light-purple count
A post I liked: solid purple heart (unchanged)
A post with no likes: white outline, no count (unchanged)
Like the 'others' post → solid; unlike → back to light-purple outline (count > 0) or white (count 0)
